subject: Recap + POC proposal: CrossBeam integration and trial plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lewis <katrina@crossbeam.com>, Evan Morris <evan@crossbeam.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: CrossBeam discovery + proposed POC approach

Hi Katrina / Evan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed next-step plan so we’re aligned before we lock dates: 

Call recap
- Primary use case: in-product knowledge assistant for partner discovery (search and rerank + short-form summaries).
- Data: product catalog + partner metadata; initial scope limited to 6 partner verticals (~200k docs).
- Success criteria discussed: accuracy on canonical intents, latency targets, and cost envelope.

Proposed POC (3-week focused trial) — high level
1) Week 0 (prep): grant API keys & read-only S3 access to sample dataset; share test prompts.
2) Week 1 (integration): implement streaming SDK route and basic intent/rerank pipeline.
3) Week 2 (evaluation): run 5k queries against agreed prompt set, capture metrics (latency, top-1 accuracy, confidence calibration).
4) Week 3 (wrap): review results, iterate, and plan production rollout options.

Technical approach (integration highlights)
- SDK: we recommend Redwood Python SDK (pip install redwood-inference). Use client.generate() for batch jobs and client.stream() for UI streaming.
- API routes: /v1/generate (sync), /v1/stream (chunked SSE/HTTP2 streaming), /v1/embeddings for dense matching.
- Tool-calling: we’ll enable function-calling for enrichment (callout to partner-metadata service). Example: function get_partner_profile(id) -> returns structured JSON for tool call.
- Authentication: short-lived API keys + token rotation for the trial; we'll supply staging keys.

Success criteria (draft)
- Latency: median response time <= 150ms for single-turn streaming median (90th <= 350ms).
- Quality: >= 88% top-1 accuracy on the canonical 500-sample intent set.
- Cost: baseline token cost not to exceed $0.02/query in trial config (subject to negotiation).

Owners & next steps
- Redwood: Jonas (PD lead) — overall program; Marissa (SE) — technical integration and SDK support; Ben (CS) — onboarding + success metrics capture.
- CrossBeam: Katrina — product lead; Evan — engineering owner; procurement (procurement@crossbeam.com) for contract terms.

Action items (I’ll attach a lightweight action sheet and proposed success criteria doc). Proposed start date: Oct 4, 2026. Can you confirm availability for that week?

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Katrina Lewis <katrina@crossbeam.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan@crossbeam.com>, procurement@crossbeam.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: CrossBeam discovery + proposed POC approach

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. This maps well to what we discussed. A few clarifications and requests from our side: 

1) Dataset access: we can provide S3 read-only + a pre-sampled test set (500 queries). We need a short data handling agreement — can you send the staging key rotation policy?

2) Success criteria: we’re comfortable with the latency goals but would like the quality bar at 90% top-1 on the 500-sample canonical set (we can flex if cost is prohibitive).

3) Streaming behaviour: our UI expects token-level updates for partial answers (SSE preferred). Please confirm the SDK supports SSE or chunked HTTP/2 streams.

4) Tool-calling: we want Redwood to call our getPartnerMetadata(...) function when the assistant needs enrichment. Can you provide a sample function signature and retry semantics?

Procurement is copied to start the contract conversation — Evan, do you want me to loop in legal now or after we confirm dates?

Best,
Katrina
Katrina Lewis | Head of Product | CrossBeam Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CrossBeam POC — technical owners & initial tasks

Internal notes / assignment: please treat as working checklist and update the attached CSV.

Technical owners
- Marissa (SE) — primary technical lead for integration + SDK examples.
- Vivek (SRE/solutions) — responsible for streaming config, SSE vs HTTP2 testing, and token rotation guide.
- Ben (CS) — measurement, dashboards (Console), and setting up evaluation harness.

Immediate tasks (this week)
- Marissa: draft SDK snippet for SSE streaming and tool-calling sample by EOD Thu. Include minimal python + JS examples. (Target: explain client.stream(endpoint='/v1/stream', on_chunk=...)).
- Vivek: prepare token rotation policy doc and staging key expiry settings (hourly vs 24h) — share by Fri.
- Ben: create eval harness template (scorecard for top-1/top-3, latency histogram, token cost calc).

I’ll attach the action_items CSV (draft). Jonas, please confirm the Oct 4 start and whether we should schedule a 30-min kickoff with their engs on Monday Oct 4 at 10am PT.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Evan Morris <evan@crossbeam.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: CrossBeam discovery + proposed POC approach

Thanks — couple quick technical clarifications from our eng lead (me):

1) Streaming: SSE is preferred. Can you confirm the SDK emits content-disposition chunks with chunk IDs and cursor offsets? We also need partial confidence scores per token for UI highlighting.

2) Tool-calling: want to see a sample function definition and error model. For example: 
function getPartnerProfile(partner_id: string) -> {id, vertical, trust_score, docs: [{id, snippet}]}
If the function fails (5xx) we need recommended retry/backoff behavior and a fallback to cached profile within the assistant.

3) Embeddings: we plan to use /v1/embeddings for dense retrieval. Expected latency for 1k doc embed batch? Please include quantization/float-mode guidance if it affects accuracy.

Also — can you provide a small code sample showing streaming + tool-calling in the same session? Even pseudo-code will help our engineers.

Evan
Evan Morris | Staff Engineer | CrossBeam Inc.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Lewis <katrina@crossbeam.com>, Evan Morris <evan@crossbeam.com>, procurement@crossbeam.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: CrossBeam discovery + proposed POC approach

Appreciate the questions — quick answers and final plan below. Attached: crossbeam_poc_action_items.csv + poc_success_criteria.md + streaming_sample_requests.jsonl

Streaming: our Python and JS SDKs support SSE and HTTP/2 chunking. The stream API yields chunk objects: {chunk_id, cursor, text, partial_confidence}. We’ll include example client.stream(..., on_chunk=handler) snippets in the SDK doc. For the UI you can render partial_text as it arrives and use partial_confidence for token highlighting.

Tool-calling: suggested function signature: getPartnerProfile(partner_id: string) -> {id: string, vertical: string, trust_score: number, top_snippets: [{id:string, snippet:string}]}.
- Retry semantics: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (200ms -> 600ms -> 1800ms). If all retries fail, the assistant should fall back to cached profile (if cache_age < 24h) and append a notice: "Enrichment delayed — showing cached data".

Embeddings: for a 1k doc batch our reference throughput on a single node is ~6s for 1536-d embeddings (quantized fp16 path). We’ll provide a quantization recommendation doc — short version: use fp16 for parity; int8/quantized modes may reduce accuracy by ~1–3% but lower CPU/GPU memory.

Plan confirmation and timeline
- Oct 4: kickoff + access exchange (S3 + staging keys + HubSpot record).
- Oct 5–12: integration window (Marissa + Vivek lead).
- Oct 13–18: evaluation run (Ben runs eval harness, we'll collect metrics).
- Oct 20: results review and next-step decision.

Deliverables we will send today
- SDK streaming snippets (python/js) — Marissa
- Token rotation & key expiry doc — Vivek
- Action items CSV (attached) and success criteria doc (attached)

If Oct 4 works we’ll lock calendar and send a 30-min kickoff invite for 10:00am PT. Katrina/procurement — once you confirm we’ll circulate a short SOW and trial terms for sign-off.

Best — Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
